say:0:1013412001:0.text: Magister Merlin, so who exactly is Atalanta?
say:0:1013412001:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，那么阿塔兰忒小姐到底是什么人？
say:0:1013412001:0.male: Magister Merlin, so who exactly is Atalanta?
say:0:1013412001:0.female: Magister Merlin, so who exactly is Atalanta?

say:1:1013412002:0.text: When we were ambushed in the Dark Forest, Atalanta appeared and saved us.
say:1:1013412002:0.source_cn: 在薄暮丛林中，我们曾被围攻，阿塔兰忒突然出现，为我们解了围。
say:1:1013412002:0.male: When we were ambushed in the Dark Forest, Atalanta appeared and saved us.
say:1:1013412002:0.female: When we were ambushed in the Dark Forest, Atalanta appeared and saved us.

say:2:1013412003:0.text: Though she has a sharp tongue, she doesn't strike me as a villain...
say:2:1013412003:0.source_cn: 阿塔兰忒虽然嘴巴有点坏，但总感觉不像是个大坏蛋？
